basic_profile.headline: Corporate Controller
basic_profile.name: Sanjiv Sharma, CPA, CIA, CISA
basic_profile.summary:
• Seasoned finance executive (CPA | CIA | CISA) with 20 + years steering global controllership, audit, risk, and compliance for blue-chip manufacturing and technology multinationals. 
• Builds and leads high-performing, cross-border teams while standardizing US GAAP & IFRS accounting and SOX frameworks across 30 + countries. 
• Architect of ERP (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle) and OneStream transformations that accelerate, close and power KPI-driven forecasting. 
• Known as a decisive change agent who blends sharp analytics with collaborative project leadership to strengthen governance, boost operational efficiency, and unlock strategic growth
• Expertise in both remote and in-person team management with strong focus on controls and compliance
• Expert speaker on various industry risks and hot topics in global conferences organized by IIA, ISACA, and others

schools.activities_and_societies: Member of Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA)

current.company_description: CesiumAstro builds and delivers space communications systems—at scale.We design, engineer, and manufacture software-defined radios, phased array payloads, and fully integrated satellites that enable real-time, multi-beam, multi-user connectivity across space-based and airborne networks. Our systems are built for mission-critical applications and designed to adapt on orbit.As a vertically integrated manufacturer, CesiumAstro brings RF, digital processing, and satellite integration together under one roof, enabling rapid production, consistent performance, and repeatable delivery.Headquartered in Austin, Texas, with operations in Colorado, California, the United Kingdom, Germany, and Japan, CesiumAstro is building the communications infrastructure modern missions depend on.We’re hiring. Explore open roles at CesiumAstro.com/careers.
